scripts.dev: bun run frontend:build && cargo run --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.build: bun run frontend:build && cargo build --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml --release && bun run bundle:macos
scripts.bundle:macos: bun -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { const result = Bun.spawnSync(['sh', 'build/darwin/bundle.sh'], { stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.exitCode ?? 1) }"
